mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fixed_costs (household_id, owner_user_id, created_by_user_id, account_id, card_id, name, amount, payment_day, include_in_household_total, created_at) VALUES (#{householdId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{createdByUserId}, #{accountId}, #{cardId}, #{name}, #{amount}, #{paymentDay}, #{includeInHouseholdTotal}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, household_id, owner_user_id, created_by_user_id, account_id, card_id, name, amount, payment_day, include_in_household_total, created_at FROM fixed_costs WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, household_id, owner_user_id, created_by_user_id, account_id, card_id, name, amount, payment_day, include_in_household_total, created_at FROM fixed_costs WHERE household_id = #{householdId} AND (owner_user_id IS NULL OR owner_user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE fixed_costs SET name = #{name}, amount = #{amount}, payment_day = #{paymentDay}, owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, include_in_household_total = #{includeInHouseholdTotal}, account_id = #{accountId}, card_id = #{cardId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, household_id, owner_user_id, created_by_user_id, account_id, card_id, name, amount, payment_day, include_in_household_total, created_at FROM fixed_costs WHERE payment_day = #{day} OR (payment_day > #{lastDayOfMonth} AND #{day} = #{lastDayOfMonth}) ORDER BY id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fixed_costs WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fixed_costs WHERE card_id = #{cardId}
